cost_inventory.formal_policy: All fixed ordered units are preserved; meanings are paid exact-whole values. No new internal semantic segmentation or transparent null unit is claimed. dar remains fixed atomicdar; daiin remains fixeddaN. opchedaiin is a separately paid exact whole, not a productive daN extension.

extra_grammar_rules.rule: dar stores the unchanged COUNTER callable; next RoleSelection directly supplies its operand and produces the result. No intervening unknown allowed.
al captures latest returned COUNTER object and awaits the next returned COUNTER object, preserving both exact object references.

cost_inventory.written_assertion_costs: Both ENTRY_CERT+FIELD whole entries are additional costs beyond the two background records. FRAME introduces only role structure and metadata, no completed episode.
cost_inventory.unknown_policy: First unknown raw form stops semantic execution; later native rows and fixed representations remain visible with dictionary entries but unexecuted. Literal entity/bracket variants never inherit IT meaning.
cost_inventory.terminal_policy: CHECK propositions and ASSERT outputs are genuine conditional terminal statements; repeated certificate assertions are explicitly redundant. Collection/reference intermediates require actual later use.
